caption: The space is already gone after preg_replace, so each number is exactly ten digits; the first digit must sit in 6–9, which gives result 1 for 9 and result 0 for 5. The ^ and $ anchors force the pattern to cover the whole string, not part of it.

spec.title: After removing spaces
spec.aria: Two cleaned ten-digit phone numbers tested against ^[6-9]\d{9}$: the first digit 9 is inside 6–9 so preg_match returns 1, while the first digit 5 is outside so it returns 0.
